summary: Clinuvel Pharmaceuticals furnished a Form 6-K attaching an ASX announcement titled CLINUVEL Annual Results Investor Webinar. The company will report financial results for the fiscal year ended 30 June 2026 on 27 August 2026, followed by an investor and analyst webinar at 18:00 AEST (10:00 CET) that day. Registration details are provided in the attached exhibit. No transaction, strategic action, or special-situation event is disclosed; the filing is a routine scheduling notice and is not a special situation.
